About Exponentia.ai

Exponentia.ai is a fast-growing AI-first technology services company, partnering with enterprises to shape and accelerate their journey to AI maturity. With a presence across the US, UK, UAE, India, and Singapore, we bring together deep domain knowledge, cloud-scale engineering, and cutting-edge artificial intelligence to help our clients transform into agile, insight-driven organizations.

We are proud partners with global technology leaders such as Databricks, Microsoft, AWS, and Qlik, and have been consistently recognized for innovation, delivery excellence, and trusted advisories.

Awards & Recognitions:

Innovation Partner of the Year – Databricks, 2024
Digital Impact Award, UK – 2024 (TMT Sector)
Rising Star – APJ Databricks Partner Awards 2023
Qlik’s Most Enabled Partner – APAC

With a team of 450+ AI engineers, data scientists, and consultants, we are on a mission to redefine how work is done, by combining human intelligence with AI agents to deliver exponential outcomes.

Learn more: www.exponentia.ai

About the Role

We are looking for AI / GenAI Engineers with 3–6 years of experience in designing, building, and deploying enterprise-grade AI applications. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience developing end-to-end AI solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Vector Search, and API-based integrations. This role requires engineers who can take AI products from concept to production, rather than focusing solely on prompt engineering.

Roles & Responsibilities
Design, develop, and deploy end-to-end AI/GenAI applications for enterprise use cases.
Build and implement RAG-based solutions leveraging LLMs and enterprise data sources.
Integrate AI models with business applications through APIs and microservices.
Develop and manage Vector Search implementations for efficient knowledge retrieval.
Fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize AI models for performance, scalability, and accuracy.
Deploy AI applications in production environments and monitor their performance.
Collaborate with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineers to translate requirements into AI solutions.
Implement security, governance, and best practices for enterprise AI deployments.
Troubleshoot, maintain, and continuously improve deployed AI systems.

Roles and Responsibilities


Preferred Skills Mandatory Skills
AI Application Development
Large Language Models (LLMs)
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
Python
API Development & Integration
AI/ML Model Deployment
Vector Databases / Vector Search
Enterprise AI Solution Development
Production Implementation Experience
Good to Have
LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or similar AI frameworks
Knowledge Graphs and Advanced Retrieval Techniques
Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or other cloud AI platforms
Docker, Kubernetes, and MLOps practices
Machine Learning & Deep Learning fundamentals
Experience building chatbots, copilots, intelligent search, or agentic AI solutions
Candidate Profile
3–6 years of software engineering and AI development experience.
Proven experience building and deploying AI applications into production environments.
Strong understanding of LLM architectures, prompt orchestration, RAG, and vector databases.
Hands-on experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise systems and APIs.
Ability to independently design, develop, and scale AI applications end-to-end.
Strong problem-solving, debugging, and stakeholder management skills.

Why Join Exponentia.ai?

Innovate with Purpose: Opportunity to create pioneering AI solutions in partnership with leading cloud and data platforms
Shape the Practice: Build a marquee capability from the ground up with full ownership
Work with the Best: Collaborate with top-tier talent and learn from industry leaders in AI
Global Exposure: Be part of a high-growth firm operating across US, UK, UAE, India, and Singapore
Continuous Growth: Access to certifications, tech events, and partner-led innovation labs
Inclusive Culture: A supportive and diverse workplace that values learning, initiative, and ownership.

Ready to build the future of AI with us?

Apply now and become a part of a next-gen tech company that’s setting benchmarks in enterprise AI solutions.

About Smart Working

At Smart Working, we believe your job should not only look right on paper but also feel right every day. This isn t just another remote opportunity - it s about finding where you truly belong, no matter where you are. From day one, you re welcomed into a genuine community that values your growth and well-being.

Our mission is simple: to break down geographic barriers and connect skilled professionals with outstanding global teams and products for full-time, long-term roles. We help you discover meaningful work with teams that invest in your success, where you re empowered to grow personally and professionally.

Join one of the highest-rated workplaces on Glassdoor and experience what it means to thrive in a truly remote-first world.

About the Role

We re looking for a Senior Full Stack AI Engineer to join a small, high-impact team working at the intersection of product engineering and AI-driven solutions.

This is not a traditional full-stack role. It s a highly autonomous, product-focused position where you ll take ownership from idea to production, working across backend, frontend, architecture, and AI-enabled features. You ll operate in a fast-paced, low-process environment, translating ambiguous stakeholder needs into working solutions while balancing rapid delivery with long-term quality.

You ll work across both improving an existing Python-based application and building new AI-powered solutions, often prototyping and shipping within short timeframes. This role requires strong engineering judgment, a proactive mindset, and the ability to bring structure and best practices into an evolving environment.

Responsibilities
Translate ambiguous stakeholder requirements into structured solutions, user flows, and deliverables
Design system architecture, making decisions around scalability, maintainability, and security
Build and deliver end-to-end features across frontend and backend with full ownership
Rapidly prototype AI-enabled solutions and evolve them into production-ready systems
Improve and scale an existing Python-based application, addressing backlog, performance, and UX gaps
Define and implement UX flows and usability improvements (not visual design, but user journeys)
Integrate with APIs, including AI-driven services, and design robust data flows
Apply secure development practices and ensure systems are reliable and maintainable
Balance speed of delivery with long-term engineering quality and structure
Contribute to and elevate engineering practices (architecture, SDLC, testing) through hands-on work
Collaborate with stakeholders and team members while operating with a high degree of independence
Requirements
Strong experience with Python (5+ years) in production environments
Proven experience in system design and architecture (5+ years), including making trade-offs
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Codex, Claude, or similar) in real workflows
Strong experience integrating APIs, including AI or data-driven services (3+ years)
Solid frontend experience with React and modern JavaScript/HTML (3+ years or equivalent frameworks)
Experience owning features or products end-to-end, from concept to delivery (3+ years)
Strong understanding of SDLC, engineering best practices, and code quality standards
Experience working in ambiguous environments and shaping requirements independently
Proven ability to prototype quickly and deliver at pace (2+ years)
Strong stakeholder communication skills and ability to translate business needs into technical solutions (5+ years)
Good understanding of UX flows and usability principles (2+ years)
Experience working with databases and data modelling (3+ years)
Understanding of secure development practices (3+ years)
Experience handling data pipelines or ETL processes (2+ years)
High ownership mindset with the ability to operate independently in a low-structure environment
Nice to Have
Experience working in small, high-autonomy teams without dedicated QA or BA support
Exposure to building AI-powered products or LLM-based workflows in production
Experience improving engineering maturity (architecture, testing, SDLC) within teams
Familiarity with rapid prototyping tools and experimentation environments
Strong product mindset with the ability to balance user needs, business goals, and technical constraints
Benefits
Fixed Shifts: 12:00 PM - 9:30 PM IST (Summer) | 1:00 PM - 10:30 PM IST (Winter)
No Weekend Work: Real work-life balance, not just words
Day 1 Benefits: Laptop and full medical insurance provided
Support That Matters: Mentorship, community, and forums where ideas are shared
True Belonging: A long-term career where your contributions are valued
5-Day AI Training: Hands-on AI Academy onboarding to get you building with AI from day one

At Smart Working, you ll never be just another remote hire.

Be a Smart Worker - valued, empowered, and part of a culture that celebrates integrity, excellence, and ambition.

If that sounds like your kind of place, we d love to hear your story.

Job Description: Senior AI Platform Engineer (Enterprise Integrations & Agent Platform)

Location: Hyderabad / Indore / Gurgaon (Hybrid)
Experience: 7-12 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time




About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior AI Platform Engineer to design, develop, and scale enterprise-grade AI platforms, intelligent agents, and integrations that transform Software Engineering and Quality Engineering workflows. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Python, Generative AI technologies, cloud-native applications, and enterprise tool integrations.

In this role, you will be responsible for building AI-powered solutions that drive automation, enhance developer productivity, and enable seamless integration across engineering ecosystems.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy scalable AI/LLM-powered applications and AI agents.
Build and maintain enterprise integrations with engineering and collaboration tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, GitHub, ServiceNow, Confluence, Jenkins, and SonarQube.
Develop REST APIs and microservices using Python and FastAPI.
Design and implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions and knowledge retrieval systems.
Create reusable Agent SDKs, AI frameworks, and shared platform capabilities.
Develop and manage MCP Servers and enterprise connectors.
Build, deploy, and manage applications using Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).
Implement observability, monitoring, logging, and telemetry capabilities for AI platforms.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, reliable, and scalable AI solutions.
Drive continuous improvements in engineering productivity through intelligent automation.



Required Skills & Experience

7-12 years of experience in software development and platform engineering.
Strong proficiency in Python programming.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI-powered applications.
Expertise in FastAPI, REST API development, and Microservices architecture.
Experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and cloud-native application deployment.
Strong understanding of Prompt Engineering, Tool Calling, and Function Calling.
Experience implementing RAG architectures, vector databases, and knowledge retrieval systems.
Experience integrating with enterprise platforms and development tools.
Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, monitoring, and observability frameworks.
Excellent problem-solving and system design skills.



Good to Have

Experience with LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, or similar AI frameworks.
Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and MCP Server development.
Experience designing and implementing Multi-Agent Systems.
Exposure to workflow orchestration and automation platforms.
Experience with Microsoft Teams integrations and VS Code extensions.
Background in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Software Engineering Productivity, or Quality Engineering.

Minimum 6 months of experience required. Freshers may also apply.


Qualification
Bachelor of Science, Bachelor of Engineering/Bachelor of Technology, B.C.A, Diploma, M.E./M.Tech, M.S., M.C.A
Roles Responsibilities:
Develop, test, and deploy AI models and algorithms for real-world applications.
Implement machine learning (ML), deep learning (DL), and natural language processing (NLP) solutions.
Preprocess and analyze large datasets for training AI models.
Optimize AI models for accuracy, performance, and efficiency.
Integrate AI capabilities into web, mobile, and cloud applications.
Research and stay updated with the latest AI trends, frameworks, and best practices.
Work with computer vision, speech recognition, and recommendation systems.
Collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, and business teams.
Skill Required:
Strong knowledge of Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, and Keras.
Experience with machine learning algorithms, neural networks, and deep learning architectures.
Proficiency in NLP libraries (Transformers, NLTK, SpaCy, Hugging Face).
Understanding of AI model deployment using Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud services.
Hands-on experience with data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model training.
Knowledge of Big Data technologies (Hadoop, Spark, Kafka) and databases (SQL, NoSQL).

Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML models and algorithms to solve complex problems.
